proposals.announcement_evidence: to exercise options for the AEGIS weapon system computing, display and peripheral equipment for DDG 125 and DDG 126
proposals.rationale: DDG 125 and DDG 126 are hulls of the DDG-51 class, and the record obligates fiscal 2017 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds — the DDG-51 SCN line's own money, not an O&M or OPN sustainment color grafted onto a construction line. Matched by description rather than name: the announcement names the hulls, not the class line. The alternative index homes for 'AEGIS Weapon System' are 5231 (OPN, Ship Missile Support Equipment) and 0604307N (RDT&E) — both would be appropriation mismatches against SCN money, which is why this proposal names the SCN line instead.

refute_b.reason: The announcement never writes 'DDG-51'; the names it does write verbatim — 'AEGIS weapon system' and 'display ... equipment' — are owned by exact-name index rows at other PEs (5231 'AEGIS Weapon System (AWS)' and 'AEGIS Combat System (ACS)'; 0604307N 'AEGIS Weapons System (AWS)' and 'AEGIS Display System (ADS)'), so the identity evidence in this paragraph points at three rows this proposal does not name, and the only thing pulling it to 2122 is the hull numbers plus the SCN color, which is lens A's ground and not an identity discriminator.
